responsibility: Implements the predefined GeneralUserExceptions family by allocating its own EXCEPTIONS source, raising enumerated problem/disaster exceptions with text, and decoding the current exception back to the module’s enumeration. It is a thin convenience layer over the generic EXCEPTIONS runtime, including the no-exception diagnostic path via M2RTS when queried outside exceptional execution.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file realizes the GeneralUserExceptions API by allocating a module-local EXCEPTIONS source, mapping the enumeration to exception numbers, and implementing the query/raise helpers; the companion .def only publishes those names and types.
